lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance, roughly circular clusters arranged in a semi-regular grid across the mid-lateral flank, extending from the posterior gill region toward the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, forming grid-like anchor nodes where blobs are centered within the vertical bands.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges visible on the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp light-above-shadow-below pixel intensity gradient.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A sparse distribution of small, high-luminance blobs visible within the macro-mask of the first dorsal fin, primarily along the leading edge and lower half of the fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: A dense concentration of significantly smaller high-luminance points located on the dorsal-lateral surface of the head, anterior to the first vertical stripe.
